title: Taming the Nine Profound Golden Thunder
summary: Deep in the Void Thunder Pool, Xiao Yan and Xiao Yi find the Nine Profound Golden Thunder, the pill lightning of ninth-grade golden pills, whose sleeping aura matches a Seven-Star Dou Sheng. A fight with Black Demon Serpents wakes it, and the Northern King Puppet cannot stop it. Xiao Yan sees it is trying to gain a mind and that its own power is tearing it apart and killing its kin. He offers help instead of taking its power by force, and Xiao Yi absorbs the excess power, which also strengthens Xiao Yan. The thunder becomes the only Nine Profound Golden Thunder with a mind. After two months away, Xiao Yan, now at late Five-Star Dou Sheng, returns to Dragon Island, where Zi Yan gives him the Void Ancient Dragons' alliance contract. Back at the Sky Mansion Alliance, Yao Lao says the Hall of Souls has pulled back all its branch halls, that the Medicine Clan's Pill Gathering is a month away, and that he wants to carve his late parents' names on the clan monument there.
events: Xiao Yan finds the sleeping Nine Profound Golden Thunder.
A fight with Black Demon Serpents wakes it.
He sees it is trying to gain a mind and is being torn apart by its power.
Xiao Yi absorbs its excess power, and the thunder gains a mind.
Xiao Yan returns to Dragon Island at late Five-Star Dou Sheng.
Zi Yan gives him the Void Ancient Dragons' alliance contract for Yao Lao.
Back at the Alliance, Yao Lao explains the Pill Gathering and his parents' wish.
cultivation: Xiao Yan reaches late Five-Star Dou Sheng ('You've gotten stronger again' / 'Just late Five-Star Dou Saint', 872.5-874.0), helped by the Nine Profound Golden Thunder's power. The thunder's aura 'rivals a Seven-Star Dou Saint'. Medusa 'leveled up too' (990.5).
